sources: Native ROM disassembly of file 29 Congo callbacks and file 12 fade helpers; symbol addresses and sizes resolved from Goemon64RecompSyms/mnsg.syms.toml.

Temporary local evidence: /private/tmp/congo-native-clean.asm, /private/tmp/congo-fade-helpers.asm.txt, /private/tmp/congo-fade-owner.asm.txt, /private/tmp/congo-fade-free.asm.txt. No ROM bytes or disassembly dumps are included in this repository.
nativeEvidence.entry: 7D24 clears root +0x68 recovery bit 1, sets +0xE8 bit 0x80, progress event 0x12D and immediate events 1 through 5. It writes the +0x8A halfword timer to 120 and queues the victory continuation; scheduling does not invoke the next callback immediately.
nativeEvidence.controller: 8022026C calls 80036B7C(owner), then writes RGB bytes +0xD/+0xE/+0xF and zero alpha byte +0x10 on the separate controller at full-system +0x3B018. The controller belongs to the task +0x18/+0x1C native object list. Root +0xDC remains a floating-point hit-sound cooldown, not fade alpha.
nativeEvidence.creation: 08008220..0800822C calls 8022026C(root,255,255,255). 820C sets the root timer to 30 and D_8015C562_15D162 to 1, then queues 8280.
nativeEvidence.rampUp: 080082C8 calls 80220210(root,4), increasing alpha to 255; return zero selects 82F8. Audio cue 0x181 occurs only when the root timer equals zero before decrement.
nativeEvidence.fadeOut: 0800830C calls 80220168(root,5). This sole Congo fade-out call subtracts alpha to zero and calls 80036158(owner,controller,1) before returning zero and selecting 833C. The object is unlinked and released; the global pointer being cleared was not established and is not claimed.
nativeEvidence.milestones: 833C clears root capability word +0x60, sets progress flags 0x12B and 0x12E, clears D_8015C562_15D162 and selects the inert callback. These writes do not replace fade-out or object release.
nativeEvidence.camera: 9298 waits for progress 0x12E; 930C sets a 90-update timer; 934C closes the letterbox; 93FC restores controls. The camera chain does not release the white fade controller.
nativeEvidence.contract: Preserve the native continuation after entry. Repeated entry restarts timing; replacing later callbacks can skip the only fade-out and release path even while camera cleanup completes.
